Quick answer

Dragostrophe is the most reliable source: 39 Pals can drop Precious Plume, and 39 of them drop it guaranteed every kill. The fastest farm is to repeatedly defeat the highest-level Pal on the list while a ranch or production line covers the rest.

How to farm Precious Plume

  • Target the guaranteed drops first — a 100% drop means one kill equals a fixed amount with no luck involved.
  • Alpha variants often add extra copies on top of the normal drop, so take the Alpha when it is nearby.
  • Pair the farm with a breeding chain so you always have a supply of the source Pal without hunting.
  • Check your base production: some sources are passive once the right structure is built.

What Precious Plume is used for

Precious Plume is used for high-tier gear crafting.

Frequently asked questions

How do I get Precious Plume in Palworld?

Defeat the Pals listed above. Dragostrophe is the most reliable source.

Dragostrophe drops up to 8 per kill with a 100% chance.

Is Precious Plume hard to farm?

No — 39 Pals drop it, and 39 drop it at a 100% rate, so a short route covers what you need.

What is Precious Plume used for?

It is used for high-tier gear crafting.
